article.title: Drawee’s time for deliberation.
article.content:
63Drawee’s time for deliberation.

Section 63  ·  Chapter V  ·  page 17 of the Act
The holder must, if so required by the drawee of a bill of exchange presented to him for acceptance, allow the drawee 2[forty-eight] hours (exclusive of public holidays) to consider whether he will accept it.
2 Subs. by Act 12 of 1921, s. 2, for “twenty-four”.
